headerEntries: The beacon casts one of the following spells (spell save {@dc 14}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The beacon uses Guiding Flame twice.

action.name: Guiding Flame (Cantrip, Evocation, V, S)
entries: The beacon forces a creature it can see within 60 feet to make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take {@h} 16 ({@damage 2d8 + 7}) Radiant damage and the next Attack Roll made against it by a creature other than the beacon before the start of the target's next turn has {@variantrule Advantage}.

action.name: Quarterstaff
entries: {@atkr mw} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft., one target {@h} 12 ({@damage 2d4 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Soothing Rays (2nd-Level, Abjuration, V, S)
entries: The beacon chooses up to three creatures it can see within 30 feet. Each creature gains 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hitpoints|XPHB} until the beacon uses this feature again. While a creature has these Temporary Hit Points, they also gain a +2 bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws.
Once the beacon uses this feature, it cannot do so again until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Flash of Warding (1st-Level, Abjuration, V)
entries: When a creature the beacon can see within 30 feet is targeted by an Attack Roll, the beacon can use a Reaction to impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the Attack Roll.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The blaster casts one of the following spells (spell save {@dc 14}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The blaster makes two Destructive Bolt attacks.

action.name: Destructive Bolt (Cantrip, Evocation, V, S, M)
entries: {@atkr ms,rs} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. one target {@h} 18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage (blaster's choice)..

action.name: Quarterstaff
entries: {@atkr mw} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft., one target {@h} 12 ({@damage 2d4 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Destructive Blast (3rd-Level, Evocation, V, S, M)
entries: The blaster chooses a point they can see within 90 feet. Each creature within a 20-foot-radius-sphere centred on that point must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw. The blaster can choose up to three creatures in the area to be unaffected.

On a failure, a creature takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage (blaster's choice) and is pushed 10 feet away from, or towards, the centre of the sphere (the blaster chooses one option for all creatures). If a creature would be pushed into an occupied space, they instead fall {@condition Prone|XPHB}. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage on a success and suffers no additional effects.
Once the blaster uses this Action, they cannot do so again until the end of their next turn.

reaction.name: Absorb Energy (1st-Level, Abjuration, V, S, M)
entries: When the blaster takes Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage, they can use a Reaction to gain resistance to that damage type (including the against the triggering damage) until the end of their next turn. The next time they deal damage of the same type with a spell attack for the duration, they deal an additional 5 ({@damage 1d8}) damage of the same type.

variant.name: Variant Damage Types
entries: The caster described above is an elemental focused caster. If you wish for an alternative, or more specific, flavor to the caster, whenever the creature's features present a list of damage types, you can choose to use a different list. Some example lists are provided below.

headerEntries: The deadeye casts one of the following spells (spell save {@dc 14}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deadeye makes two Far Bolt attacks.

action.name: Far Bolt (Cantrip, Evocation, V, S, M)
entries: {@atkr rs} {@hit 6}, range 300 ft. one target {@h} 18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) Necrotic damage. This attack ignores Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.

action.name: Quarterstaff
entries: {@atkr mw} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft., one target {@h} 12 ({@damage 2d4 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Penetrating Bolt (3rd-Level, Evocation, V, S, M)
entries: The deadeye blasts a bolt of life-draining energy in a 100-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. Creatures in the line must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw. The line penetrates objects up to 1 foot thick and ignores Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.

On a failure, a creature takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Necrotic damage and is {@condition Sundered|J:General} until the end of the deadeye's next turn. On a success, a creature takes half damage and suffers no other effects.
Once the deadeye uses this Action, they cannot do so again until the end of their next turn.

bonus.name: Bend Shot (2nd-Level, Transmutation, V, S)
entries: When the deadeye misses an Attack Roll with its Far Bolt attack on its turn, it can redirect the bolt to hit the target instead. The target takes half the damage it would have on a normal hit. This hit cannot be a Critical Hit.
Once the deadeye uses this Bonus Action, it cannot do so again until the end of its next turn.

headerEntries: The puppetmaster casts one of the following spells (spell save {@dc 14}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The puppetmaster uses Psychic Lash twice.

action.name: Psychic Lash (Cantrip, Enchantment, V, S, M)
entries: The puppetmaster attempts to lasso the spirit of a creature it can see within 60 feet with psionic string and wrench it violently, forcing the body to follow. The creature must make a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw or take {@h} 16 ({@damage 2d8 + 7}) and be pulled up to 10 feet in a direction of the puppetmaster's choice (including vertically).

action.name: Whip
entries: {@atkr mw} {@hit 6}, reach 10 ft., one target {@h} 12 ({@damage 2d4 + 7}) slashing damage.

action.name: Psionic Strings (3rd-Level, Evocation, V, S, M)
entries: The puppetmaster affixes psionic strings to a creature it can see within 60 feet. The creature must make a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be puppeteered for one minute, until it is more than 120 feet from the puppetmaster, or until the puppetmaster is {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, removing the effects on a success. The puppetmaster can have up to 2 creatures puppeteered in this way at one time.
Once on each of its turns, the puppetmaster can issue a command to each creature it has puppeteered (no action required). For each creature, the puppetmaster chooses one of the following commands:

items.name: Assail
entries: The creature makes a melee weapon attack against a target the <name> chooses.

items.name: Dance
entries: The creature moves up to half its speed in a direction the <name> chooses. This movement can trigger {@variantrule Opportunity Attacks|XPHB}.

items.name: Tangle
entries: The creature is {@condition Restrained|XPHB} until the end of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The trailblazer casts one of the following spells (spell save {@dc 14}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The trailblazer makes two Flame Blade attacks.

action.name: Flame Blade
entries: {@atkr ms} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft., one target {@h} 16 ({@damage 2d8 + 7}) Fire damage.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atkr mw} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft., one target {@h} 12 ({@damage 2d4 + 7}) slashing damage.

bonus.name: Scorching Dash (2nd-Level, Evocation, S, M)
entries: The trailblazer moves up to 45 feet. It can do this movement in one straight 45-foot line or in three sequential straight 15-foot lines. This movement ignores {@variantrule Opportunity Attacks|XPHB} and can move through the space of other creatures. Each creature the trailblazer moves within 5 feet off must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage and start {@hazard burning|XPHB}. A creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} if the trailblazer moved through its space. A creature takes half damage and is not burning on a success.
Once the trailblazer uses this feature, it cannot do so again until the end of it's next turn.

bonus.name: Skirmishing Action
entries: The trailblazer takes the {@action Dash|XPHB} or {@action Disengage|XPHB} action. Additionally, it ignores {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} until the end of the current turn.
